exclusion_reason: snes2asm only requires the portable Python yaml package. PyYAML's optional LibYAML extension is not required and would introduce compiler/platform closure; examples/tests/build infrastructure are not runtime dependencies.
baseline_reason: The pre-island toolchain resolved PyYAML 6.0.3 from PyPI in green run 36543649163, so islandization preserves that exact observed dependency version.
